data.label: video.creativedirector
data.thinking: Audience is 18-34 beauty shoppers, but the brief is a clip about a woman, not a product demo. Thesis must survive a 15s vertical without becoming an idol-template ad.

options.label: Phone-macro skin study: hard sun, anti-idol, pores and identity marks readable
options.why: Matches 'adult woman' + beauty without inventing a shop CTA the human did not write.

options.label: Glass-skin UGC demo with product and CTA
options.why: Fits template B heuristics; the human did not name a product.

options.label: Studio beauty still then I2V
options.why: More control, but ring/softbox fights a phone-macro look.

data.select_reason: Parent orchestrator picked option 1 because the human brief is a person, not a product. Option 2 would write a UGC ad the human could have typed themselves if they wanted it. Option 3 implies studio gear nobody authorized.

data.label: video.director
data.thinking: Thesis is a 15s face-stuck macro. Coverage should be one climb on the face, not a portrait pullback.

options.label: Five face-stuck beats: smash, eye/skin macro, nose/mouth super close-up, climb, one-eye hold
options.why: Keeps identity on one plane; no speech; features may clip the frame.

options.label: Three I2V clips 6/4/5 from a locked still
options.why: Imagine-family split; more vendor-shaped, still valid.

options.label: Wide-to-close hero plus product insert
options.why: Needs a product the brief never named.

data.select_reason: Creative director selected option 1 so the thesis (phone-macro skin study) is one continuous face crawl. Option 2 is a packing strategy, not coverage intent. Option 3 contradicts the no-product thesis already chosen.

data.label: video.cinematographer
data.thinking: Macro skin needs raking natural sun so pores read. Softbox would flatten the thesis.

options.label: Hard 4pm sun camera-left through half-open window and thin white sheer, 10–20cm phone-main, moving dapple
options.why: Raking key so pores and freckles read; curtain/leaves/hair cut the sun.

options.label: Overcast window, no sheer, even fill
options.why: Safer exposure, weaker pore contrast.

options.label: Beauty ring + large softbox
options.why: Idol catchlight; critic will reject.

data.select_reason: Director selected option 1 because the chosen beats stay 10-20cm on skin; a ring light (option 3) would fight every smash/macro beat. Option 2 is acceptable but weaker for the anti-idol thesis.

data.label: video.mua_makeup
data.thinking: Bare lock only. Pore manifesto is continuity, not MUA.

options.label: Sunscreen + thin moisturizer; natural brow; dusty-rose wet glaze; wet iris with real window catch; no fake lashes
options.why: Supports hard-sun pores; makeup stays a lock, not a filter.

options.label: Full base, contour, lash strip
options.why: Reads as influencer template under hard sun.

options.label: No product on skin at all
options.why: Legal, but dry flake may dominate the macro.

data.select_reason: Creative director selected option 1: enough moisture for sun speculars, not enough coverage to become option 2's idol face. Option 3 is a continuity texture choice, not makeup.

data.label: video.cameraoperator
data.thinking: One motor. Director beats are a crawl on the face; orbit would steal DoP's crop.

options.label: Handheld 1-2mm breath crawl. No push / pull / pan / orbit
options.why: Matches face-stuck beats and 10-20cm working distance.
options.craft: No traditional push / pull / pan / orbit. This is a macro crawl stuck to the face. Same adult East Asian woman the whole time. Features, moles, hair color, and skin do not morph. Stable but with real handheld breath, about 1–2mm. Features may clip the frame edge. No jump cuts. No warped face. No melted teeth. No drifting eyes.

options.label: Slow planar slider across the cheek
options.why: Cleaner, less breath; slightly less 'phone'.

options.label: Gentle orbit around the head
options.why: Breaks the no-orbit motor and recenters the face.

data.select_reason: Cinematographer selected option 1 so the motor does not add a second move on top of hard-sun crop. Option 3 is rejected: orbit was never granted. Option 2 is fine if the human later wants less shake.

data.label: video.continuity
data.thinking: Identity freeze must come from human fills, not from a host gold paste. ASK_HUMAN, then freeze what they named.

options.label: Unmarked adult freeze only
options.why: If the human names no moles.

options.label: Freeze human-named marks: left-eye mole, mouth-corner mole, sleep crease, 25-26 adult, black hair part, pale freckles
options.why: Matches what the sample human would have filled from asain-beauty-prompt.txt.

options.label: Allow identity drift across beats
options.why: Breaks the thesis; AIQA would fail.

data.select_reason: Human already froze named marks on the ASK_HUMAN lock; orchestrator confirms option 2.
